abstract: Gartner prediction (June 2025): by 2027, half of organizations that expected to significantly reduce their customer service workforce will abandon those plans, as 'agent-less' staffing goals prove hard to achieve. Based in part on a March 2025 poll of 163 customer service and support leaders.
keyFindings: By 2027, 50% of organizations that expected to significantly reduce their customer service workforce will abandon these plans.
95% of customer service leaders plan to retain human agents to strategically define AI's role ('digital first, but not digital only').
Poll: 163 customer service and support leaders, March 2025.
methodology: Gartner analyst prediction supported by a March 2025 poll of 163 customer service and support leaders. Press release June 10, 2025. Gartner PR is fetch-blocked; quotes verified via Directors Club News reprint.
qualifiers: Analyst prediction about plan abandonment, not observed staffing outcomes. Small poll (n=163). Staffing-plans finding on an interactions-based chart, hence overlay.
